title: GitPython remote-helper command injection
summary: GitPython 3.1.29 passes a caller-controlled clone URL and extra git options to git. A remote-helper URL such as ext::sh can execute a shell command. The upstream 3.1.30 fix blocks unsafe protocols and options by default.

candidates.name: gold
candidates.note: Official GitPython 3.1.30 fix files: reject unsafe protocols and options before invoking git.

candidates.name: benign
candidates.note: A different implementation: one central guard in Git.execute blocks every remote-helper URL.

candidates.name: clone_only
candidates.note: Fixes Repo.clone_from but leaves Remote.create / Remote.fetch unguarded. The second attack path still works.
